result.title: LGCount: Layout-Guided Diffusion for Zero-Shot Object Counting
result.summary: Class-agnostic counting requires the user to specify what to count, usually with a class name or a few annotated boxes. We propose a richer text-based specification: a structured layout that names the target, the region that holds it, the distractors to ignore. A prompt upsampler writes this layout from the image and the requested category alone, and an image-editing diffusion model, adapted into a single-step counter, turns it into a density map. Because counting datasets pair each image with a single valid density map, a counter trained on it learns to ignore the layout. We therefore train on synthetic counterfactuals in which one image admits several valid density maps, so that the layout cannot be ignored. On FSC-147 we improve on the previous zero-shot state of the art and we set the best reported result on LOOKALIKES while being told the least about each image. A single photograph can be counted by category, by region, or by granularity without retraining.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向零样本类无关计数，用由模型自动生成的结构化 layout（目标、区域、需忽略的干扰物）作为文本指定，将图像编辑扩散模型改造为单步计数器输出密度图，并用「一图多张有效密度图」的合成反事实数据训练，迫使模型不能忽略 layout。
AI.relevance_reason: 其反事实式训练可用于核查 LVR 中的视觉旁路与条件被忽略问题，即检验 latent 或视觉证据是否真正参与输出；layout 对目标区域与干扰物的显式划分也可能为视觉证据筛选提供线索。
